title: From low to high
summary: Joining the low strings to the high ones.

steps.title: Where the halves meet
text: The low notes and the high notes meet between the 4th and 3rd strings. After **F** on the 4th string comes the open 3rd string, **G**.

steps.title: A scale
text: Eight notes in a row, from one letter to the same letter higher up, make a **scale**. This is the scale of C, from the C on the 5th string to the C on the 2nd.

steps.title: The C scale
text: Up the scale and back down. It crosses four strings.

steps.title: Across the join
text: Four bars that keep crossing between the 4th and 3rd strings.
